Anya: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Anya: Did: landed kernel patch that reduces scheduling jitter for microbatches (PR #4532). Ran a 1h perf sweep on canary, p95 generation latency down ~15% for 512-token loads.
Anya: Blockers: seeing a small uptick in KV evictions on heavy prefix-share workloads when batch sizes spike; not sure if it's the eviction heuristic or a stats-sync delay.
Anya: Today: instrument eviction path, add per-shard eviction counters, and test with synthetic mixed-prompts.
Matt: Nice! link to PR?
Anya: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4532 — main change is slot coalescing + better backpressure window.
Olivia: Heads-up — my integration tests for Dedicated saw ~5% tail regressions when the canary hit burst >120 req/s, might be related to the same KV churn.
Kai: Can you paste the evict logs from the canary run?
Anya: paste below (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T22:13:04Z WARN kv/shard-12 evict: threshold=0.78 entries=812 used=0.84 
2026-03-17T22:13:04Z INFO kernel/batcher slot_coalesce=enabled batches=312 p95=182ms
2026-03-17T22:15:09Z WARN kv/shard-12 evict: threshold=0.78 entries=790 used=0.81
```
Anya: Looks like bursts correlate with short-lived increase in `used` > threshold and immediate eviction churn.
Matt: @Kai @Lee can you try toggling `evict_window_ms` from 100 -> 250 on a canary shard and rerun Olivia's scenario? If that smooths it, we'll make it adaptive.
Kai: On it. Will run bench: `python -m bench.run --profile mixed_prompts --concurrency 140` and report. ETA ~90m.
Lee: If it is windowing, we should also instrument `kv.cache_hits_during_eviction` to see if useful entries are being evicted. I'll add a quick metric in the exporter.
Olivia: Thanks — I'll re-run Dedicated integration once Kai has the windowed canary.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/4532 started on cluster-canary-7 (slots: 8 GPU) — 6:14 left
Anya: Action items: 1) Kai: windowed canary run, 2) Lee: add eviction-hit metric, 3) Anya: add per-shard counters + follow-up PR if we need adaptive window.
Matt: If windowing helps, let's patch the default to 200ms and add AB test.
Anya: Sounds good. I'll queue a small follow-up PR to expose `evict_window_ms` as an override per-deployment.
Kai: Quick note — if anyone else is debugging the perf run, avoid restarting canary-7 until I finish, will conflict with logs.
Anya: kthx. :thumbsup:
Matt: thanks team, ping me if you need help analyzing the flamegraphs.
Olivia: I'll drop the integration results here when done.
Lee: PR for metric coming up in ~30m.
Anya: End-of-thread update expected in ~2.5h with numbers.
